Flight delays: Delays and cancellations: covered when caused by an official weather warning, an airline fault or the traveller's illness. Receipts are required. Not covered: a delay under six hours, a strike that was announced before the policy was bought, or a cost the airline already paid.
Lost baggage: Lost bags: paid at current value, not the price when new (a bag two years old is paid at about half), up to the baggage limit. The airline's loss report must be attached. Items left unattended are not covered.
Medical: Medical: covered for illness or injury during the trip, up to the medical limit, with a doctor's or hospital invoice. Existing conditions are not covered unless they were declared when the policy was bought.
Limits and sign-off: Payout: the amount claimed, capped at the limit for that kind of claim, minus the excess. Any payout over S$800 needs a handler's signature. When unsure, refer the claim to a handler.
Reasonable costs: Reasonable costs: a hotel, meals and transport are paid when needed because of a covered delay, with receipts. Luxury upgrades are not reasonable. If a cost looks high, refer the claim.
Strikes: A delay or cancellation caused by a strike is covered only if the strike was not announced before the policy was bought.
Used items: Lost or damaged items are paid at their current value, not the price when new. A bag two years old is paid at about half.
Weather: A cancellation caused by an official typhoon warning is covered. A delay with no warning is not.
